gold_question: This system is an automobile sales management system, which is mainly used to manage the information of companies, categories and dealers. The system allows users to add, delete and update company information, and each company has a unique ID and name. At the same time, category information can also be managed by category ID and company ID to ensure that each category belongs to a company, and when a company is deleted, all categories under the company will also be deleted. The dealer information includes dealer ID, name and company ID, which supports dealers to belong to a company or not to any company (that is, the company ID can be empty). When a company is deleted, the system will set the company ID of all dealers under the company to NULL. Companies and categories, as well as companies and dealers are associated through Foreign key to ensure data integrity and consistency.
nl_text: The rschema_0097 database is designed to store information about companies, categories, and dealers. The company table contains a list of companies, each identified by a unique company ID and name, which cannot be left blank. The category table stores categories, each with a unique category ID and name, which also cannot be left blank, and is associated with a specific company, which is also required. The relationship between a category and its company is such that if the company is deleted, all categories associated with it will also be deleted. The dealer table lists dealers, each identified by a unique dealer ID and name, which cannot be left blank, and is also associated with a specific company, which is required. Similar to the category table, if a company is deleted, all dealers associated with it will also be deleted. The company ID is used as a foreign key in both the category and dealer tables to establish these relationships, ensuring that only valid company IDs can be referenced.
